name: Claude Bridge
description: Forward chat /claude commands to local Claude Code (`claude -p`) running in a fixed project directory.

projectCwd.description: Absolute path to the project directory where `claude` runs. Falls back to env OPENCLAW_CLAUDE_BRIDGE_CWD.

claudeBin.description: Name or absolute path of the claude CLI binary.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to wait for claude to finish before killing the process.

maxReplyChars.description: Truncate the reply to this many characters (Telegram has a 4096-char hard limit).
